Amulet_of_Rao.description: Amulet of Rao is an artifact recommended for the Controller role and available from a feat for opening 10 Kryptonian Time Capsules.

sections.heading: Artifact effects
items: Your Controller Debuffs are (20/30/40/50)% stronger and deal damage over time to (1/2/4/7) additional enemies equal to (0.6/1.2/1.8/2.4)% of your Vitalization and (0.15/0.3/0.45/0.6)% of your Might.

B_O_P_Commlink.description: B.O.P. Commlink is an artifact for the Controller role.

sections.heading: Artifact effects
items: While in Controller Role, coordinate an attack with the Birds of Prey, applying Expose Weakness to your target. All Controller debuffs now last 6 seconds.
* Black Canary's attack reduces target's healing ability.
* On hitting an enemy target with 3 debuffs on it, will grant power to you and your group members.
* Double the amount of power granted by Siphon Weakness.

Compound_Omega.description: The Compound Omega is a legendary consumable available from Doctor Fate (Vendor). It is a buff to temporarily increase all role statistics.

sections.heading: On use
items: . 5% Health - Group (+1800s). 5% Power - Group (+1800s). 5% Restoration - Group (+1800s). 5% Vitalization - Group (+1800s). 5% Dominance - Group (+1800s). 5% Might - Group (+1800s). 5% Precision - Group (+1800s)

Sinestro_s_Corrupted_Power_Ring.description: Sinestro's Corrupted Power Ring is an artifact recommended for the damage role with superpowers and/or controllers.

sections.heading: Artifact effects
items: Granting group members power has a (15/30/45/60)% chance of powering up the Avatar of Fear for (10/20/30/45) seconds. Cooldown 60s
Consuming power has a (15/30/45/60)% chance of powering up the Avatar of Will for (10/20/30/45) seconds. Cooldown 60s
The Avatar of Fear unleashes an explosion of Fear at the next target you damage increasing their damage taken & restoring your power and Super charge.
The Avatar of Will unleashes an explosion at your current target whenever you damage an enemy

Soder_Cola_Extreme.description: Soder Cola Extreme is a common, low-level consumable. Found as a dropped item, granted as a mission reward, and even purchased from vendors, this cola can be used to replenish an amount of both Health and Power.

sections.heading: On use
items:
+50 to +90 % of Max Power - Self
''+45 to +80 % of Max Health - Self

The_Transformation_Card.description: The Transformation Card is an artifact recommended for the Damage role.

sections.heading: Artifact effects
items: Gain 20% critical chance and 30% critical magnitude on your attacks and heals. Reduce your total damage and healing done by (21/19/17/15)%.

Nth_Metal_Detector.description: A Nth Metal Detector is available from the marketplace. It is also included in Booster Bundles.

sections.heading: Effects
items: Upon activation, for one hour, a Nth Metal Cache may drop from enemies, similar and in addition to regular Nth Metal (Artifacts) drops. Depending on timing, the droprate is up to six Caches per use.

The hour continues after relogging, appears in the Current Effects, and has a visual effect of gold sparkles around the character while active. Consuming multiple detectors concurrently does not extend the time; the timer is an hour from last one consumed.
